from: Credentials stay encrypted on this Windows account.
to: Read-only keys are encrypted in your cloud vault and sent over HTTPS to the HardEarner service for provider requests.
tr: Salt okunur anahtarlar bulut kasanda şifreli saklanır; sağlayıcıya istek yapmak için HTTPS ile HardEarner hizmetine gönderilir.

from: I created a dedicated read-only key, disabled trading and withdrawals, and authorise encrypted storage on this computer.
to: I created a dedicated read-only key with trading and withdrawals disabled. I authorise encrypted cloud storage and transient use by HardEarner to read my account.
tr: Alım satım ve çekim izinleri kapalı, ayrı bir salt okunur anahtar oluşturdum. Şifreli bulut saklamasını ve hesabımı okumak için HardEarner tarafından geçici kullanımını onaylıyorum.

from: This is my own bank account. I authorise balance reads and encrypted storage of this token on this computer.
to: This is my own bank account. I authorise balance reads through HardEarner and encrypted storage of this token in my cloud vault.
tr: Bu benim banka hesabım. HardEarner üzerinden bakiyemin okunmasını ve belirtecin bulut kasamda şifreli saklanmasını onaylıyorum.

from: Check that the key still exists and has not expired. If IP restrictions are enabled, they must allow this computer’s internet connection.
to: Check that the key still exists and has not expired. IP restrictions must permit the cloud service. This preview has no fixed outgoing IP; keep an IP-restricted key in the desktop app until fixed-IP support is available.
tr: Anahtarın var olduğunu ve süresinin dolmadığını kontrol et. IP kısıtlaması bulut hizmetini kapsamalıdır. Bu önizlemenin sabit çıkış IP adresi yok; sabit IP desteği gelene kadar kısıtlı anahtarı masaüstü uygulamasında kullan.

from: Local credentials and cached balances will be removed. Manual purchases stay saved.
to: This removes the connection from your current cloud vault and synced browsers. Recent encrypted backups can retain it. Manual purchases stay saved.
tr: Bağlantı mevcut bulut kasandan ve eşitlenen tarayıcılardan kaldırılır. Son şifreli yedeklerde kalabilir. Manuel alımlar korunur.

from: Saved on this device
to: Saved to your encrypted cloud vault
tr: Şifreli bulut kasana kaydedilir

from: Windows notifications
to: Browser and in-app notifications
tr: Tarayıcı ve uygulama içi bildirimler

from: Last 200 notices saved on this device. Incomplete wallet syncs do not trigger alerts.
to: The latest 200 notices are saved in your encrypted cloud vault. Incomplete wallet syncs do not trigger alerts.
tr: Son 200 bildirim şifreli bulut kasanda saklanır. Eksik cüzdan eşitlemeleri uyarı tetiklemez.

from: Connected balances appear in Holdings automatically. Only possible overlaps with manual entries need review. Sync runs every five minutes while this browser is open and unlocked.
to: Connected balances join Holdings automatically. Review possible duplicates. Sync runs every five minutes while this browser is visible and unlocked.
tr: Bağlı bakiyeler Varlıklara otomatik eklenir. Olası çift kayıtları incele. Bu tarayıcı görünür ve kasa açıkken beş dakikada bir eşitlenir.

from: Spot, Funding and Simple Earn. Margin, Futures, Options and other Earn products are not included.
to: Spot, Funding and Simple Earn. Margin, Futures, Options and other Earn products are not included.
tr: Spot, Funding ve Simple Earn. Margin, Futures, Options ve diğer Earn ürünleri dahil değildir.

from: Exchange balances, including available and locked TRY and crypto.
to: Exchange balances, including available and locked TRY and crypto.
tr: Kullanılabilir ve kilitli TL ile kriptolar dahil borsa bakiyeleri.

from: Spot balances, including available and locked crypto and TRY.
to: Spot balances, including available and locked crypto and TRY.
tr: Kullanılabilir ve kilitli kripto ile TL dahil Spot bakiyeleri.

from: Spot balances and Earn / reward balances returned by BalanceEx. No derivatives wallets.
to: Spot balances and Earn / reward balances returned by BalanceEx. No derivatives wallets.
tr: BalanceEx ile dönen Spot ve Earn / ödül bakiyeleri. Türev cüzdanları dahil değildir.

from: Advanced Trade accounts accessible to this API key. Other portfolios may need a different key.
to: Advanced Trade accounts accessible to this API key. Other portfolios may need a different key.
tr: Bu API anahtarının erişebildiği Advanced Trade hesapları. Diğer portföyler farklı anahtar gerektirebilir.

from: Trading and Funding wallets in Spot account mode. Earn, derivatives and margin are not included.
to: Trading and Funding wallets in Spot account mode. Earn, derivatives and margin are not included.
tr: Spot hesap modunda Trading ve Funding cüzdanları. Earn, türevler ve Margin dahil değildir.

from: Use your own Twelve Data key. It is stored encrypted on this device and sent only to Twelve Data. Available exchanges, fundamentals and delays depend on your subscription; HardEarner does not buy a plan for you.
to: Your personal Twelve Data key is encrypted in your cloud vault. Requests pass through our Cloudflare relay to Twelve Data; the relay temporarily processes the key but does not intentionally log it. Your provider plan determines coverage and delays.
tr: Kişisel Twelve Data anahtarın bulut kasanda şifrelenir. İstekler Cloudflare aracımız üzerinden Twelve Data’ya gider; aracı anahtarı geçici olarak işler, kaydetmeyi amaçlamaz. Kapsam ve gecikme sağlayıcı paketine bağlıdır.

from: Daily results begin after the next price refresh. Earlier days are not invented. Keep HardEarner running in the tray to collect observations.
to: Daily results begin after the next price refresh. Earlier days are not invented. Keep this browser open and the vault unlocked to collect observations.
tr: Günlük sonuçlar bir sonraki fiyat yenilemesiyle başlar. Eski günler üretilmez. Gözlem toplamak için bu tarayıcıyı ve kasayı açık tut.

from: Private desktop support: can.yazicioglu.p@gmail.com. Never send API secrets or passwords.
to: Private support: can.yazicioglu.p@gmail.com. Never send API secrets or passwords.
tr: Özel destek: can.yazicioglu.p@gmail.com. API sırlarını veya şifrelerini asla gönderme.

from: For alerts, send a test notification and check Windows notification settings.
to: For alerts, keep this page visible and unlocked, send a test notification and check browser permission.
tr: Uyarılar için bu sayfayı görünür ve açık tut, test bildirimi gönder ve tarayıcı iznini kontrol et.

from: Preferences, sources, and your local data.
to: Preferences, sources, and your private data.
tr: Tercihler, kaynaklar ve özel verilerin.

from: Report saved on this computer. Nothing was sent.
to: Report downloaded. Nothing was sent.
tr: Rapor indirildi. Hiçbir şey gönderilmedi.

from: Credentials and analysis are encrypted separately and are not included in JSON backups.
to: Manual portfolio JSON exports omit credentials and analysis. The full encrypted vault backup above includes them.
tr: Manuel portföy JSON dışa aktarımlarında anahtarlar ve analiz yoktur. Yukarıdaki tam şifreli kasa yedeği bunları içerir.
